speaker: Ms Hazlina Abdul Halim
text: asked the Minister for Foreign Affairs (a) whether the Government will consider convening an inter-ministry taskforce or involving Singaporeans to consolidate relief, rebuilding, and restructuring efforts for Gaza in a strategic manner; and (b) what other initiatives can be piloted by the Government to safeguard harmony and cohesion amongst different communities in Singapore, against the backdrop of the Gaza conflict.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: I seek your approval to answer all 13 Parliamentary Questions which have been filed on the same subject.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: These would be Question Nos 1 to 6 for oral answer and Question Nos 26 to 32 for written answer.
